arxiv-2309-03813.title: Anderson mobility edge as a percolation transition
arxiv-2309-03813.creator: Marcel Filoche, Pierre Pelletier, Dominique Delande, Svitlana Mayboroda
arxiv-2309-03813.description: Abstract The location of the mobility edge is a long standing problem in Anderson localization. In this paper, we show that the effective confining potential introduced in the localization landscape (LL) theory predicts the onset of delocalization in 3D tight-binding models, in a large part of the energy-disorder diagram.

arxiv-2406-10260.title: Flextron : Many-in-One Flexible Large Language Model
arxiv-2406-10260.creator: Ruisi Cai, Saurav Muralidharan, Greg Heinrich, Hongxu Yin, Zhangyang Wang, Jan Kautz, Pavlo Molchanov
arxiv-2406-10260.description: Abstract Training modern LLMs is extremely resource intensive, and customizing them for various deployment scenarios characterized by limited compute and memory resources through repeated training is impractical. In this paper, we introduce Flextron , a network architecture and post-training model optimization framework supporting flexible model deployment.

arxiv-2412-20981.title: Witten’ın kübik açık sicim alan teorisinde analitik çözümler üzerine Dedication: Durmuş Ali Demir’in anısına
arxiv-2412-20981.creator: İlmar Gahramanov K,B,c
arxiv-2412-20981.description: Abstract Bu makale, 2024 yılında “Feza Gürsey Fizik Günleri” okulunda verdiğim derse dayanmaktadır. Makalede, takyon vakumu için açık kübik sicim alan teorisinin analitik çözümleri (özellikle Erler-Schnabl çözümü) kısaca gözden geçirilmektedir. 1 Giriş 2023 yılının Aralık ayında, Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi Fizik Kulübü tarafından düzenlenen “Fizik Konferansı”nda, Durmuş Demir hocayla birlikte konuşmacıydık.

arxiv-2502-20334.title: Economic Censorship Games in Fraud Proofs
arxiv-2502-20334.creator: Ben Berger, Edward W. Felten, Akaki Mamageishvili, Benny Sudakov
arxiv-2502-20334.description: Abstract Optimistic rollups rely on fraud proofs — interactive protocols executed on Ethereum to resolve conflicting claims about the rollup’s state — to scale Ethereum securely. To mitigate against potential censorship of protocol moves, fraud proofs grant participants a significant time window, known as the challenge period, to ensure their moves are processed on-chain.

arxiv-2503-17456.title: Language-specific Neurons Do Not Facilitate Cross-Lingual Transfer
arxiv-2503-17456.creator: Soumen Kumar Mondal, Sayambhu Sen, Abhishek Singhania, Preethi Jyothi
arxiv-2503-17456.description: Abstract Multilingual large language models (LLMs) aim towards robust natural language understanding across diverse languages, yet their performance significantly degrades on low-resource languages. This work explores whether existing techniques to identify language-specific neurons can be leveraged to enhance cross-lingual task performance of low-resource languages.

arxiv-2505-19852.title: Density-Functional Green Function Theory: Dynamical exchange-correlation field in lieu of self-energy
arxiv-2505-19852.creator: F. Aryasetiawan
arxiv-2505-19852.description: Abstract The one-particle Green function of a many-electron system is traditionally formulated within the self-energy picture. A different formalism was recently proposed, in which the self-energy is replaced by a dynamical exchange-correlation field, which acts on the Green function locally in both space and time.

arxiv-2509-11540.title: Positive Definiteness and Stability of Interval Tensors Thanks: The first author’s work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of P.R. China (Grant No.12171064)
arxiv-2509-11540.creator: Li Ye, Yisheng Song
arxiv-2509-11540.description: Abstract Abstract. In this paper, we focus on the positive definiteness and Hurwitz stability of interval tensors. First, we introduce auxiliary tensors \mathcal{A}^{z} and establish equivalent conditions for the positive (semi-)definiteness of interval tensors. That is, an interval tensor is positive definite if and only if all \mathcal{A}^{z} are positive (semi-)definite.

pmc-10649473.title: Protocol for a mixed-method study to assess chronic cough in patients with renal cell carcinoma: the prevalence, impact on quality of life, trigger and potential clinical application of chronic cough as an early screening tool in patients with kidney cancer

pmc-12680937.title: Impact of Digital Interventions on the Treatment Burden of Patients With Chronic Conditions: Systematic Review
pmc-12680937.creator: Manria Polus, Pantea Keikhosrokiani, Olli Korhonen, Woubshet Behutiye, Minna Isomursu
pmc-12680937.description: BackgroundDigital interventions can provide cost-effective, quality health care for patients with chronic conditions. pmc-13382656.title: Antipyretic and Antinociceptive Activities of Tri-Phol-That Extract and Its Flavonoids: In Vivo and In Silico Evidence
pmc-13382656.creator: Thitaporn Sae−jia, Adisorn Sirichotejirakul, Pacharathon Simking, Sinsamut Sae−Ngow, Worathat Thitikornpong, Watchara Damjuti
pmc-13382656.description: Despite the common use of herbal medicines rich in flavonoids to treat fever and pain, the pharmacological mechanisms involved in these effects are poorly understood. Therefore, this study assessed the antipyretic and analgesic effects of Tri-Phol-That extract, characterized its major flavonoids, and investigated its possible molecular interactions with key inflammatory mediators.

pmc-13540797.title: Comparative evaluation of zoomed and parallel diffusion-weighted imaging: A phantom study
pmc-13540797.creator: Akiyoshi Iwase, Yasuo Takatsu, Naoki Ohno, Azusa Kitao, Tosiaki Miyati
pmc-13540797.description: Objectives:Single-shot echo-planar imaging sequences with parallel imaging are widely used for diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI). However, when small fields of view and higher phase-encoding reduction ratios (PRs) are applied, image quality may deteriorate because of imperfections in the unfolding process of parallel imaging. Previous studies have suggested that Zoomed DWI (Zoom-DWI) may address this limitation.
